The '''Thanta Zilbra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system was [[Destruction of Thanta Zilbra|destroyed]] by [[Centerpoint Station]] as the first inhabited system hit in the [[Corellian Crisis|Starbuster Plot]]; evacuation efforts by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] were incomplete, and casualties numbered in the tens of thousands.
